body: I look forward to seeing many old and new friends in London this weekend. I’ll be part of the Faithworks conference , and also speaking at church.co.uk Sunday evening at 6:30 p.m. This weekend also marks the UK release of A New Kind of Christianity: Ten Questions That Are Transforming the Faith, so there will be lots of opportunities to sign books and meet long-time and first-time readers. If I look jet-lagged, you’ll know I didn’t manage to sleep well on the flight across the Atlantic!
